title: Kenyan Chicken Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew from Kenya, featuring tender chicken and a rich blend of spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic, carrots, and potatoes, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the stew spice mix, chili peppers, and beef broth, and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
